scope: The 1 admitted X509_VERIFY_POLICY production obligation(s) in src/ct/ct_sct.rs that the enumerated SSH closure reports as reachable but without an owning boundary receipt are enumerated here for ownership only, at their census coordinates, with a hazard read from each function.
